title: Ninety-Five Percent of Manufacturers Are Investing in AI
summary: Rockwell reports that quality control remained the top AI use case and that 50% of surveyed manufacturers planned to apply AI or machine learning to product quality in 2025. This is adoption context, not proof of LineSight outcomes.

title: BlueScope Saves Around 2,000 Hours with Predictive Maintenance
summary: A Siemens customer case reports roughly 2,000 hours of avoided unplanned downtime using Senseye. It supports pilot interest but is vendor evidence from a different operation, not a transferable guarantee.

title: Predictive Maintenance for Automotive Smart Manufacturing
summary: Siemens states that AI may flag issues while experienced technicians and engineers remain central to diagnosis and resolution.

title: Siemens Expands Industrial Copilot with Generative AI Maintenance Offering
summary: Siemens announced maintenance-cycle capabilities spanning repair, prevention, prediction, and optimization, showing competitive movement toward integrated maintenance workflows.

title: AI in Action: Beyond Experimentation to Transform Industry
summary: The report identifies predictive maintenance, quality control, and production automation as focus areas for advanced manufacturers.
